stages.gate: User approves Stage16T and separate custody/resources; no execution implied by technical recommendation.
stages.name: Protocol approval

stages.gate: Separately authorized; pass implementation fixtures and source freeze; one draw in custodian; public aggregate certificates only. Failed support retains draw and blocks automatic progression.
stages.name: Implementation, challenge generation and independent audit

stages.gate: Separate user authorization after protocol/support review; existing Train/Validation only;40-field frozen semantics; challenge extractor code may be tested on fixtures but no challenge data exposed.
stages.name: V4 development feature construction

stages.gate: Separate preregistered plan, <=36 fits; Train fit/Validation selection; sparse-family learning limitations remain; no challenge outcomes or old holdout access.
stages.name: Model development

stages.gate: Recorded hashes of all artifacts, calibration/threshold and evaluation code; challenge commitment already fixed.
stages.name: Model and evaluation freeze

stages.gate: Separate authorization; custodian loads frozen artifacts, computes outputs once; no fitting; all support counts and results released together with failed objectives and uncertainty.
stages.name: Independent challenge evaluation

stages.gate: Separate estimands and all12 families/3domains, qualified failure/indeterminate statements; original holds remain quarantined. Later result-informed work requires new evaluation.
stages.name: Final reporting

stop_now: Design only. No transactions, features, models, thresholds, evaluation or secret streams.
